title: Word-boundary localization from intracranial activity

titles: Brain Treebank naturalistic movie/language intracranial recordings

scientific_question: Can intracranial observations localize word starts in held people and movies beyond independently timed acoustic/visual cues, on a label-independent continuous grid?
primary_outputs: Whether each fixed grid sample lies within the frozen inclusive tolerance of any manually annotated word start; offsets and sentence-only onsets are different targets.

data_manifest.version: Unversioned author release; source URLs and sampled HEAD ETags/Last-Modified captured2026-10-29. Release first public2024.

recording_contract.neural: Author quickstart reads sub_<id>_trial<id>.h5, group data, electrode_<number> one-dimensional arrays; sampling frequency2048Hz and voltage plotted in microvolts per author source. No HDF5 neural array header/value independently opened because recordings are compressed in large ZIPs.
recording_contract.labels: Actual transcript CSV header includes text, lemma, pos, deprel, sentence_idx, word_idx, idx_in_sentence, start/end, gpt2_surprisal, mel/RMS/pitch, motion/brightness and speaker features. Subject metadata JSON identifies movie; electrode-label/localization archives provide anatomy.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Actual timing CSV header is type,movie_time,start_time,end_time,trig_type,index,diff. Author code maps word start/end movie times to neural sample indices from nearest trigger plus2048Hz interpolation. Alignment error and dropped triggers remain empirical checks.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Ten clinical participants;26recording/movie presentations and21unique movie IDs confirmed from all26public subject metadata JSONs. Repeated movies across participants are stimulus overlap, not independent unseen stimuli.
recording_contract.evidence: Author quickstart source, full small subject-metadata archive and first header line of one timing CSV and one transcript CSV inspected; no neural values or media retrieved.

inputs: Source intracranial signals with declared 2048 Hz alignment and nonpositive neural feature lags; native channel calibration/selection requires verification.
Continuous audiovisual windows for a separate fixed comparator, timed independently of target word annotations.
forbidden_inputs: Word timestamps, transcript rows, onsets/labels or answer-bearing movie identities in query metadata
Word-aligned loudness/motion rows as supposedly independent nuisance inputs
Future neural/context features and query-derived feature/anatomy selection
allowed_inputs.case_identity: catalog.json enumerates all26 IDs such as sub_1_trial000. Public export binds recording/fold IDs and label-independent grid start/stop/step/count; public source IDs still permit external label lookup unless transport restricts it.
allowed_inputs.split: Every recording is tested exactly once; fold train/test share neither person nor movie. Minimal joint person/movie components are {1,5},{2},{3,4,6,7,10},{8},{9}; all corresponding records remain grouped.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All26 recording presentations and all eligible uniform-grid bins; grid depends on duration/guard, not word labels. Actual HDF5 and transcript extraction are not delivered by the exporter.

primary.name: participant_macro_word_start_average_precision
primary.aggregation: Pool eligible bins within each participant, compute tie-grouped noninterpolated AP at natural prevalence, then equal-person mean across10 people.
primary.rationale: Measures withheld word-start information without label-selected query bins; AP is not trapezoidal PR area.

secondary: Per-person prevalence, bin counts and class-balanced diagnostic separately from primary
No-wrap latency-shift diagnostic on an explicitly identical interior subset
Full recording/fold coverage and null AP if a person has no positive bins

comparators.name: Acoustic/visual continuous-window decoder
comparators.inputs: Independently timed continuous loudness, spectral and motion features, no word-aligned timestamps
comparators.procedure: Operator-owned frozen probabilities under identical folds; scorer interface exists, native competent fit not delivered.

comparators.name: Constant prevalence
comparators.inputs: Training-fold prevalence with no neural signal
comparators.procedure: Valid weak predictor; constant AP equals test prevalence as a diagnostic.

comparators.name: Latency-shifted neural probabilities
comparators.inputs: Same candidate outputs shifted beyond tolerance and feature support
comparators.procedure: Implemented no-wrap diagnostic; not a universal null under arbitrary autocorrelation.

nuisance_controls: Use whole person/movie connected components to block repeated stimulus leakage.
Define a uniform query grid before labels; balancing weights may be diagnostic but cannot label-select query timestamps.

evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented paired participant percentile bootstrap is descriptive for10 selected clinical participants. It does not capture repeated-movie clusters or shared-fit dependence; those limits accompany any inferential claim.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject missing/extra/duplicate IDs, mismatched folds, wrong vector lengths and invalid probabilities. No-positive participant AP makes macro AP null, not an omitted participant; constants remain valid.
